hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $15$ are $1, 3, 5,$ and $15.$

$15$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $45$ are $1, 3, 5, 9, 15,$ and $45.$

$45$ has $6$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $63$ are $1, 3, 7, 9, 21,$ and $63.$

$63$ has $6$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $73$ are $1$ and $73.$

$73$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.

The factors of $88$ are $1, 2, 4, 8, 11, 22, 44,$ and $88.$

$88$ has $8$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.
